name: Summer Youth Sailing Program
description_short: Summer sailing and windsurfing classes for ages 5-17 at Community Boating Center on Padanaram Avenue in New Bedford, held rain or shine: one-week Summer Youth Sailing (ages 7-17, 8:30-2:45), one-week Sea Squirts (ages 5-6, mornings, with sailing, games, swimming and a literacy activity) and two-week Windsurfing (ages 9-17). Up to two sessions per sailor; free breakfast and lunch; financial aid for those who qualify.
swim_waterfront_notes: On-the-water program held rain or shine; students should come prepared to get wet. Closed-toe shoes (water shoes or old sneakers) are mandatory; bring a bathing suit, towel and change of clothes. Sea Squirts (ages 5-6) mixes sailing, games and swimming, with a focus on water safety. Staff limit on-the-water activity when they judge conditions unsafe.
